claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show only black PlayStation-branded packaging with the text “WILCOX HARRY”; no console internals/specs are visible.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired.
claims.evidence: Photos show packaging/box only; no seal/opening status of the actual console is shown.
No power-on/temperature/usage test photos or logs are shown.
Back of the packaging shows holes/fixtures, but no proof the actual console ports function.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No included accessories or receipt are shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: The photos may be only the packaging/box, not the actual PS4 Pro console (model/version and condition unknown).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the actual console (front + back ports) with the model label visible, plus a power-on/boot screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not verified console (worst case: packaging-only / untested), so value should be treated as low until the actual unit is confirmed.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (could be standard PS4, PS4 Slim, or another PlayStation unit) despite the seller claiming PS4 Pro.
risks.proof: Photo of the console model number/label (e.g., CUH-xxxx) and storage capacity shown on the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case model (standard/unknown) and untested status.

risks.risk: Port failures or missing parts (even if ports exist, they may not work; accessories may be missing).
risks.proof: Video showing multiple ports in use (HDMI connected + display, USB device connected, controller charging) and a full accessories laydown photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/untested accessories and potentially faulty ports.

risks.risk: Console may be banned/locked or previously reported (region/account lock, network restrictions).
risks.proof: Photo of the console system settings showing account/region status and a successful sign-in/network connection test (or a clear system info screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially locked/banned until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Controller issues (drift, dead buttons, faulty charging port) if controllers are included.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of controller sticks/buttons + a video test showing controller input response and charging.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller may be faulty or not included.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal problems not detectable from packaging photos.
risks.proof: A short gameplay/benchmark video (or at least a power-on session) plus a temperature/thermal warning check if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially overheating/needs service (worst case) until tested.

proof_requests: Send photos of the actual console (front and back) showing the model label and storage capacity.
Send a power-on/boot video showing the PS logo and system menu (or settings screen).
Show a full accessories laydown photo (controller(s), cables, headset/stand if any) and confirm what “original pads” means.
Provide a clear photo of the UK receipt (or invoice) and match it to the console serial/model.
Show controller condition: close-ups of sticks/buttons and a short input/charging test video.
Show at least one working port test: HDMI to TV + USB device/controller charging.
response.reason: The witness photos only confirm PlayStation-branded packaging text and do not prove the actual console model, condition, or functionality. Without power-on/model-label/accessory proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
